purpose: Direct-locator international accountability tranche: materialize five courts, monitoring, execution-supervision and human-rights institutions from exact repository-retained source surfaces without turning judgments, inspections, precautionary measures or external reporting into institutional governance outcomes.
migrationRule: An institution counts as migrated only when its ABox record points to a dedicated institution dossier. Exact judgments, inspection findings, execution-supervision records, precautionary measures and human-rights statements remain proposition-specific evidence; institutional identity does not create ECL governance, Material Participation or generic effectiveness findings.
visualRule: Derived visuals display State context and the exact curated evidence proposition, then terminate at the institution identity boundary. State S context and evidence-producing or remedial adjacency never propagate to the institution.

visualModel.source: ECtHR Petrov v. Moldova judgment (5 Mar 2026)
visualModel.proposition: Court found degrading treatment, discrimination and forced labour violations linked to Moldova's informal prisoner hierarchy
visualModel.boundary: Judgment evidence does not classify the Court or mechanically determine ECL governance
